scope: Public official product documentation and pricing only. No account, trial, purchase, plugin installation or profile collection was performed by this reviewer.
main_recommendation: Do not buy a paid tool yet. The coordinator's free LinkedIn pilot worked without an observed commercial-search restriction; its bottlenecks were buyer-intent ambiguity, project ownership and a supported team maximum. Improve intent queries and candidate verification first. Core remains a conditional future trial for demonstrated combined-filter or volume friction. Premium Business is relevant only if ordinary search limits become the primary obstacle. Neither plan proves that a core product is unbuilt, that its complete software team has at most two people, or that its owner intends to pay an external builder.

coordinator_live_pilot_final_snapshot.interpretation: The completed pilot supports continuing free research. Its 59 post impressions are not a deduplicated lead denominator, so no lead-conversion rate is asserted. No volume restriction was observed; buyer intent, project ownership and supported team maximum remained the material evidence gaps. Zero fully qualified fits in this bounded pilot does not establish that suitable buyers do not exist.

known: Current public LinkedIn US starting prices and documented feature categories were checked on official pages.

Core includes advanced search. Current official filter definitions include company, title, geography, tenure and department/company headcount; official glossary documents recent-post and job-change spotlights.
Premium Business documents unlimited people/company search; LinkedIn Help also documents additional Premium filters such as Actively hiring.
Apollo documents employee/department counts, job postings, geography, titles and company-activity filters.
Crunchbase documents company, team, funding and growth filters. MAGNiTT documents venture/funding research and customized enterprise subscriptions.

tools.best_use: Find candidate founders using several company/person filters together, then inspect the underlying product and team evidence.
verified_capabilities: Current and past company; current and past job title; function and seniority.
Person geography and company headquarters location.
Company headcount and account department headcount; growth filters exist at account level.
Years in current company and position.
Spotlights for changed jobs within 90 days and posting within 30 days.
Lead/account profiles, advanced searches and alerts.
important_limits: Total company headcount is not software-team size. Department counts reflect LinkedIn data and do not establish a complete contractor-inclusive maximum.
Recent posting does not mean the post contains a build request; new founder title or recent job change does not prove a new unbuilt company.
Company-size restrictions can miss unincorporated founders or businesses without a populated company page; keep a separate search without that restriction.
No verified documented filter directly proves an unbuilt core product, cash development budget or willingness to buy outsourced software.

tools.upgrade_trigger: Not met in the reported pilot. Reconsider only after two comparable free sessions show that unavailable combined founder/company-size/geography controls consume over half of discovery time, or an explicit commercial-search restriction prevents planned exact-name checks. Buyer-versus-vendor noise alone is insufficient, because Core does not certify paid intent. Test against the same research brief before subscribing long term.
tools.trial_success_criterion: Proposed experiment: at least 30% lower discovery minutes per unique evidence-supported pre-build candidate over comparable batches, or demonstrably restores blocked exact-name work, without increasing unknown team/product cases. Continue only if downstream fully qualified yield also improves. Thresholds are analyst proposals, not vendor promises.
